overview_description.description: The Indian restaurant industry has already adopted technology to adapt to the growing demands and match the expectations of today's customers but the absence of a full-stack cloud-based software is extremely frustrating to business owners today. The existing systems lack modularity, lack the ability to integrate with services, and hence aren't plug and play. Also, Restaurants are extremely frustrated with all the 5-6 independent systems that don't talk to each other.   We are solving these problems by building a full-stack solution for the 30 million+ restaurants in India, by solves order management, operations management, online delivery, payment processing, reports & analytics, and guest identification and re-engagement all using one system - Explorex. Location: 420 S 4th Street Unit 15, Ames, IA, us, 50010

about_short_description.short_description: Explorex is an all-in-one ecosystem of software suite & business management platform for offline businesses.

product.name: Bridge by Explorex
product.description: A cloud-based restaurant management platform integrating ordering, payments, and operations to streamline restaurant workflows.

product.name: Front of the House Management
product.description: A system to manage walk-in guests, queues, and reservations with real-time updates and customer notifications.

product.name: Digital Menu
product.description: A dynamic digital menu accessible via QR code that allows real-time updates and scheduling of menu items and prices.

product.name: Automated Ordering
product.description: A web-based ordering system allowing customers to place orders and pay via mobile devices without app downloads.

product.name: Integrated POS/mPOS
product.description: A cloud-based point of sale system managing orders, table settlements, discounts, and user access rights.

product.name: Integrated Payments
product.description: A payment solution enabling diners to pay via web app, UPI QR codes, or EDC devices with auto table settlement.
